name: King Arthur's Round Table
place: Yanwath and Eamont Bridge, Westmorland and Furness, England
summary: King Arthur's Round Table is a Neolithic henge in the village of Eamont Bridge in the English county of Cumbria, around one mile (2 km) south east of Penrith. It is 400 metres from Mayburgh Henge. The site is free to visitors and is under the control of English Heritage.
